verdict.rationale: Conductor documents a public API at /docs/api for managing cloud workspaces programmatically: creating workspaces, sending prompts to the coding agent, and reading its replies. That lets an AI-native user drive the core agent workflow. The API is scoped to cloud workspaces, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec. Missing for 10: API coverage of local (non-cloud) workspaces, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, documented endpoint/auth details in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
